neos.name: New-Hire RSUs
neos.comp_raw: A grant of RSUs in the aggregate amount of $7,500,000, which vest 1/3 on each of the 1st, 2nd and 3rd anniversary of the grant date. Subject to his timely execution and non-revocation of a release of claims, Mr. Jabre's New-Hire RSUs that would otherwise have vested over a one-year period will fully accelerate following Mr. Jabre's termination of employment if (i) such termination is without cause or for good reason (each as defined in his offer letter) and (ii) his Change of Control Severance Agreement has not been triggered. If Mr. Jabre’s employment is terminated due to his death or disability, such RSUs immediately vest.

neos.name: Sign-on Bonus
neos.comp_raw: $6,565,500 as a one-time bonus subject to 100% repayment by Mr. Jabre if he voluntarily terminates his employment within 12 months of his start date and 50% repayment by Mr. Jabre if he voluntarily terminates his employment after 12 months but within 24 months of his start date.

neos.name: New-Hire PBRSUs
neos.comp_raw: Grants of PBRSUs in the aggregate amount of $7,500,000 as follows: • $3,750,000 subject to the same performance criteria (50% TSR and 50% Billings) as the Fiscal Year 2024 PBRSU awards granted to the other Executive Vice Presidents as described in the Company's 2024 Proxy Filing), except that the Billings metric will based on Billings performance for fiscal 2026. The PBRSUs will vest, if earned, after the completion of fiscal 2026. • $3,750,000 in PBRSUs subject to the same performance criteria (50% TSR and 50% Billings) as the Fiscal Year 2025 PBRSU awards granted to the other Executive Vice Presidents (as described in the Long-Term Equity Incentive section), except that the Billings metric will be based on Billings performance for fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2027. The PBRSUs will vest, if earned, after the completion of fiscal 2027. Subject to his timely execution and non-revocation of a release of claims, Mr. Jabre's New-Hire PBRSUs continue to vest at 100% of target in accordance with the grant agreement following Mr. Jabre's termination of employment if (i) such termination is without cause or for good reason (each as defined in his offer letter) and (ii) his Change of Control Severance Agreement has not been triggered. If Mr. Jabre’s employment is terminated due to his death or disability, such PBRSUs immediately vest at target.
